title: Some findings on the role of forestry sector group in sustainable development in Vietnam: an approach from input–output analysis
core_idea: Use the national input–output analytical framework and the most recent national IO table to quantify the forestry sector group's economic and environmental significance in Vietnam, focusing on its role in mitigating greenhouse gas (CO2) emissions, contributions to value added, and level of import dependence.
tldr: The study applies input–output analysis to assess how Vietnam's forestry sector group influences CO2 emissions, value added, and import reliance, aiming to inform sustainable development policy decisions.
